newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica's Sasko, Bokomo to merge.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica's Sasko, Bokomo to merge.

text.p: South African non-listed food companies Sasko (Pty) Ltd and Bokomo (Pty) Ltd said on Friday they will merge and form a group with combined assets of 1.5 billion rand.
The two companies said in a joint statement that the new group will have an annual turnover of more than 3.5 billion rand while projected annual earnings would be around 130 million rand.
"There is a powerful synergy between us which can be exploited to benefit our shareholders and can provide important new opportunities for employees," the companies said.
The new group may seek a listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange but no date had been set yet, the companies said.
The merger will be subject to shareholder approval and approval from South Africa's Competition Board.
Both companies are former cooperatives and have more or less the same shareholders.
